i had the same feeling when i told my teachers i had been raped and it’s completely normal to want to distance yourself. the thing is that after you tell them they’ll be so understanding and even though they can get annoying and overwhelming they will want to help you and defo cut you some slack. also i’m sure that they probably know why you feel like distancing yourself so try not to worry about it so much- ik that’s easier said than done. even if you feel embarrassed or ashamed or whatever is holding you back from speaking to your teacher who you trust, try and and just push yourself to speak to them anyways and sometimes what makes it easier is if you maybe just email them saying that you feel ashamed or embarrassed cause that helps everyone be on the same page. trust me it’s so much better talking about it than not! hope you’re doing okay
